    # 4) after construction, perform a simple intra-route improvement:
    #    try to swap adjacent customers if it reduces route distance (using a simple

    if not customers:
        return []

    custs = []
    seen = set()
    for c in customers:
        cid = int(c['id'])
        if cid in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(cid)
        custs.append({'id': cid, 'demand': int(c.get('demand', 0))})

    custs.sort(key=lambda x: x['id'])

    capacity = int(instance.get('capacity', 0))
    vehicles = max(1, int(instance.get('vehicles', 1)))

    routes = []
    route_caps = []  # used capacity per route

    for c in custs:
        did = c['id']
        dem = int(c['demand'])
        placed = False

                routes[i].append(did)
                route_caps[i] += dem
                placed = True
                break

                routes.append([did])
                route_caps.append(dem)

            routes[-1].extend(last)
            route_caps[-1] += cap
        else:
            # put back by re-adding as separate route
            routes.append(last)
            route_caps.append(cap)
        i -= 1

        # take from last route and move to previous if possible
        donor = routes.pop()
        dcap = route_caps.pop()

                routes[-1].extend(donor)
                route_caps[-1] += dcap
            else:
                # cannot merge; keep as standalone (best effort)
                routes.append(donor)
                route_caps.append(dcap)
                break
        else:

            route_caps.append(dcap)
            break

    # Use distance proxy: abs(a - b)

                continue

                cur = abs(a - b)

                swapped[j], swapped[j+1] = swapped[j+1], swapped[j]
                nab = swapped[j]
                nb = swapped[j+1]
                # new local: abs(nab - nb)
                new = abs(nab - nb)
                if new < cur:
                    # apply swap
                    route[j], route[j+1] = swapped[j], swapped[j+1]
                    improved = True

    final_routes = []

        filtered = []
        for cid in r:
            if cid not in seen_ids:
                filtered.append(cid)
                seen_ids.add(cid)
        if filtered:
            final_routes.append(filtered)

    # If any customer missing due to earlier dedup, add them in new routes
    all_ids = set(c['id'] for c in custs)
    missing = all_ids - seen_ids
    for mid in sorted(missing):

        final_routes.append([mid])
